purpose: Official DSH is the primary behavioral reference. Explicit cross-language mappings are reviewer-supplied hypotheses, not AST equivalence assertions.

pairs.label: Output limit before tool dispatch
pairs.notes: Shared stop contract. Different loop decomposition: an official step maps to part of the Go whole-turn method. Tree structure is evidence for review, never semantic equivalence.

landmarks.note: Inspect branch order relative to tool execution.
Call names are language-specific; missing landmark is a review prompt, not a failed behavioral test.

pairs.label: Sticky output-limit turn outcome
pairs.notes: Once any step reaches output limit, a later normal follow-up cannot downgrade the turn result. Error/cancel precedence must still be checked by tests.

landmarks.note: State lifetime spans the turn, not one model response.

pairs.label: Assemble safe completion at output limit
pairs.notes: Official neutral assembler and Go Chat Completions assembler have different roles. Both must discard unsafe tool calls at output truncation; replay-envelope support remains a separate capability.

landmarks.note: Review the keep/drop decision and retained text/reasoning.

pairs.label: Classify context overflow before generic request size
pairs.notes: Official Messages and Go Chat Completions are different transports. Compare category precedence, not exact field/schema equality.

landmarks.note: Explicit context overflow should remain distinct from generic HTTP 413.
Authentication failures retain their category.

pairs.label: Validate usage counters at boundary
pairs.notes: Official component counts are exclusive Messages values. Cached<=prompt in Go is a separate Chat Completions conversion invariant, not a literal upstream rule.

landmarks.note: Inspect safe-integer and negative-count handling. AST terms alone cannot prove arithmetic safety.

pairs.label: Bounded physical-line window
pairs.notes: Official streaming scanner and Go bounded decoded-text presentation differ in implementation. Go retains 16 KiB total cap; official default is 50 KiB. Verify empty/terminal-newline/CRLF cases by regression.

landmarks.note: Review physical line counting, especially the terminal newline.

pairs.label: Explicit continuation after truncated output
pairs.notes: Official returns a line-numbered text envelope; Go returns a JSON ReadWindow. Compare continuation contract, not output syntax.

landmarks.note: Next read must start at a complete line boundary.

pairs.label: Prompt cancellation owns admission
pairs.notes: AbortController/Go context are analogous cancellation mechanisms. Preserve admission ownership and request slot until settlement.

landmarks.note: Cancellation must cover the time before Agent installs its active canceler.
Inspect claim/release order rather than counting assignments.

pairs.label: Cancel admitted prompt and active work
pairs.notes: Official descendant/output settlement is richer; Go supports current synchronous in-process subset. Compare actual cancellation wiring, not full ACP feature parity.

landmarks.note: Cancel the admission controller/context, not only an already-active Agent.

pairs.label: Keep prompt slot through cancellation cleanup
pairs.notes: Go waits for the active Agent to become idle before releasing its ACP slot after cancellation; official also drains descendants/output updates.

landmarks.note: Tests must establish no next-prompt overlap while cleanup remains active.

pairs.label: Unterminated JSONL record boundary
pairs.notes: Default rejects unterminated records. Explicit complete-tail recovery validates full session under writer lease, preserves exclusive backup, and restores only the delimiter. Unlike official fragment recovery, incomplete JSON is never discarded or truncated.

landmarks.note: Review committed-record boundary, then use persistence tests for bytes-on-disk effects.

pairs.label: Writer-lease protection before durable append
pairs.notes: Default rejects unterminated records. Explicit complete-tail recovery validates full session under writer lease, preserves exclusive backup, and restores only the delimiter. Unlike official fragment recovery, incomplete JSON is never discarded or truncated.

landmarks.note: A writer lease is required before mutation, but does not itself prove crash recovery.

pairs.label: Empty declared table remains initialized storage
pairs.notes: Retained generic KV backend, not current CLI JSONL. An empty declared table directory must prevent legacy bootstrap from resurrecting deleted records.

landmarks.note: Inspect directory recognition before deciding to bootstrap legacy data.
Unknown directories must not suppress valid bootstrap.

pairs.label: Todo content and duplicate normalization
pairs.notes: Go retains Legacy library default and explicit DSH mode. CLI composition must select DSH mode separately; AST body match cannot establish which option was mounted.

landmarks.note: BOM and NEL require runtime Unicode regression, not naive TrimSpace correspondence.
Normalized duplicates must be rejected.

pairs.label: Mount DSH-compatible todo policy
pairs.notes: Official tool registration versus optional Go CLI composition. The mapping highlights policy selection; it does not equate full projection/plugin assembly.

landmarks.note: Compare effective options and durable event behavior with CLI fixtures.

pairs.label: Respect resources-only server capabilities
pairs.notes: A server without tools capability need not implement tools/list. A capabilities guard should precede discovery.

landmarks.note: Ensure resources-only initialization remains valid.

pairs.label: Canonical MCP structured result integration
pairs.notes: Canonical value and supported output schema now flow through the existing tool registry. Existing Go text/image projection is retained; this does not claim complete official rich-attachment/PTC rendering parity.

landmarks.note: Presence on both sides does not prove preservation when ordinary content also exists.
